$Comment: The library's sample track world rule, switched off: turn it on in track-world-rules.json with { "Zc_Track_Example_Arenas": { "Enabled": true } } and, in any world whose name holds Arena, the sample track gains nothing while every other track gains half, and the stats every track's picks grant are taken off until the player leaves (Grants.Kinds.Stat false, a PvP arena's rule). A world's own gameplay config can say the same in its Plugin group as ZigTrackRules, and then that wins for the world.
